text: The school should adopt the later start time as it offers numerous benefits. Evidence A confirms that full crossing-guard coverage is in place, ensuring the safety of our students. Evidence B makes it the first district statewide to test this model, showing that it has the potential to set a new standard. Additionally, Evidence C highlights a significant cost savings on bus routes, which can be reinvested into the education system. Most importantly, the pilot school has seen an improvement in attendance every term since switching, emphasizing the positive impact this change can have on our students' academic success. By adopting the later start time, we can ensure a safer, more efficient, and better-prepared student body.
